descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Zen Heart Sutra VR brings the ancient Heart Sutra (Hannya Shingyo) to life in
  an immersive virtual reality experience. Sit in a traditional Japanese zen
  room, surrounded by tatami floors, shoji screens, and seasonal garden views.

  # Features

  - **Full Heart Sutra** in brush calligraphy with furigana, modern Japanese
  translation, Romaji, and English translation
  - **Interactive instruments** — mokugyo (wooden fish drum) and orin (singing
  bowl) with realistic 3D spatial audio
  - **Six spatial presets** — Zen Room, Dark Meditation, Mosaic Mandala, Cloud
  Sky, Flower Field, and Real Mandala
  - **Mixed Reality mode** — meditate in your own room using device passthrough
  - **Seasonal gardens** — Spring cherry blossoms, Summer green, Autumn foliage,
   Winter snow
  - **Time-of-day lighting** — Morning, Day, Evening, Night
  - **Adjustable playback speed** and ambient BGM
  - **Freely reposition** all canvases in 3D space

  Perfect for daily meditation, mindfulness practice, or experiencing the beauty
   of Japanese Buddhist tradition in VR.
